title: 浮点误差：0.1+0.2、大数吃小数与 Kahan 补偿求和
expected_output:
=== why 0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3 ===
  0.1          = 0.10000000000000000555
  0.2          = 0.20000000000000001110
  0.1 + 0.2    = 0.30000000000000004441
  0.3          = 0.29999999999999998890
  (0.1+0.2)==0.3           -> false
  exact difference         = 5.55111512312578270212e-17

=== catastrophic absorption (big eats small) ===
  (1e16 + 1.0) - 1e16      = 0.0   (the 1.0 is completely lost)
  1e16 + 1.0 == 1e16       -> true

=== naive vs Kahan compensated summation ===
  sum of 0.1 one million times, naive = 100000.0000013329
  sum of 0.1 one million times, Kahan = 100000.0000000000
  error of naive                     = 1.332883e-06
  error of Kahan                     = 0.000000e+00

=== tolerance comparison ===
  fabs(diff) < eps with eps=1e-9   -> true

rule: never compare floats with ==; use an absolute or relative tolerance
for money use integer minor units (cents) or a decimal type
